C0979.title: Naraka: Bladepoint to Penalize Players Who Queue with Cheaters
C0979.summary: Naraka: Bladepoint officials have banned approximately 6,000 cheating players, but users report that sanctions for those deliberately teaming up with cheaters to boost rank are less effective than penalties for direct cheating.
